coverage_explanation: Tests the explicitly required LCD text and sensor-to-display updates at startup, after humidity-only and temperature-only changes, at zero-valued readings, and after returning to earlier readings. The host LCD text checks cannot verify rotation, cursor coordinates, text color, text size, black-background clearing, or the exact loop delay. Thus the graphics-specific success criteria are not fully covered.
assumptions: The supplied wiring is authoritative: DHT22 data pin 2; LCD RST 8, D/C 9, CS 10, MOSI 11, MISO 12, SCK 13. No bench wiring defaults are needed.
Temperature is interpreted in degrees Celsius, consistent with the supplied temperature input API and the default DHT library readTemperature() behavior.
The requirement does not specify decimal precision. Text checks use integer-valued stimuli and accept the required label and integer prefix, including ordinary decimal renderings such as 40.00.
Each input state lasts four seconds to accommodate the DHT API's two-second cached sampling interval.
Invalid-reading behavior is unspecified and is not tested.
